title: A logo hint whose url was re-signed finds the media row its picture was deduplicated onto, and a from-scratch research reads that logo again
steps: S1: a social source's profile picture hint carries a new url and the mediaId the media step recorded; the stored row has the older url of the same picture. List the logo candidates.
S2: bind logo hints of an Instagram, a website and a Tripadvisor source to the rows their urls became.
S3: decide which logo research to keep when a run found none with zero candidates while the found logo on record is still in the snapshot, and when it is not.
S4: research the logo of S1 with a vision model, again with the earlier research, and again forced.
expect: S1: one candidate, the kept row, via social-profile.
S2: only the Instagram profile picture gains mediaId; a second pass changes nothing.
S3: the found research is kept while its row is in the snapshot; the none is stored otherwise.
S4: found; the second run reuses the reading (no call), the forced run calls the model again.
evidence: dev 09/11/2026: a whole Research again stored logoResearch status none with zero candidates over a found Instagram logo; the new signed url of the profile picture was kept as the older row (same sha256), and hints matched rows by url only
fence: logoCandidatesOf matches a hint by its recorded mediaId; logoResearchToKeep refuses a zero-candidate none over a found logo still in the snapshot

tests: a social profile picture hint with a re-signed url finds the row its picture was deduplicated onto
the media step binds each logo hint to the row its url became, and leaves other items alone
a none that looked at zero candidates never replaces a found logo still in the snapshot
a from-scratch run reads the logo found under a re-signed url again with vision
